newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wage pressures strong - Reith.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wage pressures strong - Reith.

text.p: Australian Industrial Relations Minister Peter Reith, commenting on the latest figures on wages deals, said wage pressures in key industry sectors remained strong.

"The latest result in large part reflects the influence of several major agreements in retail and aviation (sectors) which paid moderate wage increases," Industrial Relations Minister Peter Reith said in a statement.
But the underlying trend in enterprise bargaining outcomes in small- to medium-sized firms was largely unchanged, he added.
"In key industry sectors -- notably metals manufacturing and construction -- wage pressures remain strong."

Reith's department said new enterprise-bargaining deals concluded in the quarter granted average annualised wage rises of 4.4 percent, down from the 4.8 percent rises granted in the September quarter.
Deals concluded in the private sector also granted 4.4 percent rises, down from 5.3 percent previously.
